subtitle: Lesson 19 · Backup & Recovery with T-SQL

caption: CHECKSUM catches a corrupt page at backup time, not restore time.

code:
BACKUP DATABASE AdventureWorks2012
TO DISK = 'D:\Backups\AdventureWorks2012_Diff.bak'
WITH DIFFERENTIAL, COMPRESSION, CHECKSUM;

-- captures every extent changed since the
-- LAST FULL, not since the last differential
caption: Differentials grow larger the further from the last full.
